EEGReference: BioSemi CMS/DRL (online); no offline reference applied
EEGPlacementScheme: Custom ultra-high-density layout (~14 mm centre-to-centre) over occipital, parietal and frontal areas; channel labels follow 10-5 names but positions are custom (Chamanzar et al. 2021, Fig. 2). No digitized positions were released.
TaskDescription: Auditory steady-state task: 1 kHz tones amplitude-modulated at 4 or 6 Hz for 2 s over insert earphones, fixation cross on screen; inter-stimulus interval 1-1.5 s. On ~10% of trials the participant responded with a key press.
